Fifty keys cost an afternoon and forty dollars. Tenure does not: a key signs the challenge with an address whose first outgoing transaction sits 730 days back and paid fees in 24 separate months, read from block headers, not screenshots.

Brokers price aged funded accounts near 80 dollars, so fifty clones run 4,000 dollars, and each transfer waits its age check before the copy votes. Renting history fails since the seller keeps the seed.

Terrace walls settle one course a year; a relic keeps the wear of the hands that dropped it, and a comet repeats the orbit of its first pass.
